messages:
emma_sales: Quick heads-up — reseller 'EdgeNorth' (UK) asking for partner margin exception to win a regulated POC with a large bank. Need deal-desk + finance + legal. @rafael_partnerships @meera_dealdesk

rafael_partnerships: details? what's the deviation from our UK channel rate card?

emma_sales: They want 32% off list for a 60d POC. Proposed post-POC: 27% if partner secures a £250k ARR commit within 9 months. Our UK channel rate card default is 20%. Link: https://redwood.company/rate-cards/uk

meera_dealdesk: that's a big lift. Any MDF asks or PS needs? currency exposure?

emma_sales: MDF £8k one-time. PS ask: ~50 hours of integration/enablement. Partner prefers monthly invoicing for cashflow.

lu_ps: noted. If MDF doesn't cover PS time, we'll request a PS voucher. Also require SOW to capture scope + any SLA relaxations.

tom_finance: monthly invoicing acceptable but require explicit payment terms and AR contact in the opp. MDF should be coded to co-marketing; finance wants an MDF clawback clause if commit not met. Need a quick margin delta table for RevOps.

rafael_partnerships: I'm open to a timeboxed POC concession (60d) only if: 1) partner-signed commit addendum with clear MDF clawback, 2) partner agrees to proof-of-customer-commit milestones, 3) RevOps updates forecast + CRM tagging, 4) legal signs off on reseller terms. I'll coordinate partner signature.

meera_dealdesk: Opening DD-10022 to track approvals and conditions. Please attach CRM opp id, margin calc, SOW, and proposed clawback language. https://redwood.company/dealdesk/DD-10022 :eyes:

deal-bot: Ticket DD-10022 created — status: Open. Awaiting finance + legal review.

emma_sales: CRM opp ID: RDW-UK-7302. Quick inline calc for reviewers:

```
POC list price: £60,000
Requested discount: 32% -> customer pays £40,800
Partner margin (proposed): 20% on net -> £8,160
One-time MDF: £8,000
Approx net to Redwood on POC: £40,800 - 8,160 - 8,000 = £24,640
Baseline (20% discount): customer pays £48,000 -> Net delta on POC ~ +£3,360 vs concession
```

tom_finance: need USD equivalent for RevOps model and confirm VAT handling. Also clarify whether MDF is prepaid cash or a credit against future commissions.

meera_dealdesk: propose trigger language: partner must provide signed customer commitment or verifiable pipeline (customer PO or contract) to qualify for post-POC 27% margin within 30 days of POC end. If not met, discounts revert and MDF clawback applies.

legal-bot: Routing reseller addendum + clawback language to legal for review. Expect ~72h turnaround for redlines and DPA alignment.

rafael_partnerships: I'll coordinate partner on signing addendum and scheduling PS. Approve proceeding to prep partner-facing docs pending DD-10022 signoffs. :thumbsup:
